basic_info.description: Investor special! 47 Curtis Street is a spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath single-family home offering over 2,200 square feet of potential in a prime San Francisco location. Perfect for contractors, developers, or savvy investors looking to renovate or reimagine a property with great upside. Featuring a large footprint and situated on a quiet residential block, the home is ready for transformation. Close to public transportation, shopping, dining, and commuter routesdon't miss this rare opportunity to add value in a highly desirable neighborhood.
